editorial.blurb: A Logan Square standout where creative tacos and stellar churros arrive hot and fresh, backed by genuine warmth from the team and a self-order QR setup that keeps things flowing.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab a seat, hit the salsa bar next to the counter for extra verde and avocado options beyond the complimentary chips and warm salsa, then order the Al pastor or Korean taco — they're substantial enough that one or two will fill you up.
